title: Hash Definitions
description: Shared hash field definitions for all DKB primitives

sha256_hash.description: SHA-256 hash in lowercase hexadecimal format (64 characters)

canonical_hash.description: Canonical SHA-256 hash of receipt - immutable after issuance

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of input payload in canonical form

state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of state at a point in time

prev_state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of previous state in chain

next_state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of next state in chain

replay_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of replay verification result
